invariants.rationale: Instant time is used in the commit operation and is likely required to be non-null.
Partition path is used as a key in a map passed to commitInternal and should not be null.
The records collection is provided by callers and used in commit operations, so it is expected to be non-null.
indexParser is an argument that might be used by callers for consistent metadata parsing and expected to be non-null.
instantTime, representing a commit or operation timestamp, is expected to be a non-empty string.
